= Orchid Changelog

== 0.2.0

* Replaced `generate-link` with `orcid`. Write the author's name alongside the call.
* The default displays the icon and full HTTPS URL as a single link. Use
  `orcid(id, display: none)` for the previous icon-only default or
  `orcid(id, display: "id")` for the compact format.
* Added separate options for icon position, displayed text, and which parts are linked.
* Added `orcid-url` for the canonical URL and `orcid-icon` for the icon alone.
* Accept ORCID URLs as input and validate the ISO 7064 check digit.
